title: lasallea caroliniana
intro: Lasallea caroliniana, commonly known as Carolina Sapphire or Carolina Bluebeard, is a flowering shrub native to the southeastern United States. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Lasallea caroliniana include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may aid in protecting against cell damage and promoting overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of the plant include phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
